limitations: Separate active-desktop sessions; existing applications running during MLX and new Orion trials. No cross-runtime paired confidence intervals or isolated peak claims.
Different graph and cache layout: CoreML input window 64/context512; MLX input width1/context1024; Orion stride32/context1024. Precision and layer norm policies differ.
Native C/Swift engine timers and Python graph construction timers cover similar decode outputs but different frontend work. Request throughput is separately recorded for CoreML and MLX.
Orion CPU/ANE pass all tested top1/KL gates but fail raw-logit NRMSE gates; MLX FP16 fails the Hello-world choice gate. Not full-logit or general accuracy equivalence.
CoreML ALL static plan preferred GPU for all 418 nonconstant operations; it is not a combined CPU+GPU+ANE speed measurement.
No vllm.cpp throughput number is possible through its current GPT-2 text-generation interface; it has only a host backbone reference used by IndexTTS.
orion_older_reference: Original 69.82/61.41 two-token pair remains historical; current row uses one fresh three-context run. Five Orion source files differ from that earlier captured snapshot.
